The JCC describes weekday home pickup and return for seniors attending its activities, wellness programs, trips and lunches. This is a senior-program service, not a general public route; confirm eligibility, fares and booking notice.

We provide daily transportation for seniors to visit the JCC. Every weekday, seniors are picked up at their homes and transported to the J for fun activities, wellness programs, trips, and lunches, and then returned home.
